plain: Hard-working and careful, keeping at a task.

webster.text: Constant in application; as a person assiduous in his occupation.

more.text: Attentive; careful; regular in attendance; as an assiduous physician or nurse.

example.quote: The assiduous merchant, the laborious husbandman, the active mechanic, and the industrious manufacturer,--all orders of men, look forward with eager expectation and growing alacrity to this pleasing reward of their toils.
